name: People of Mine
detailed_description:
People of Mine is a 2D psychological horror that explores themes of identity, memory, and the masks we wear to hide from the truth.

Story

You play as John, an FBI agent on a mission to destroy a mysterious cult infecting a decaying city. But nothing is quite what it seems. The enemies, known as “Cultists,” look human. Too human. And when the line between reality and memory begins to blur, the truth becomes harder to swallow.

Beneath the surface lurks Jack, a violent personality buried deep in John’s subconscious. Every action, every killing is part of something greater… or something broken.
You’re not just hunting monsters.
You might be creating them.

Key Features

  • Dual-Personality Narrative
    Experience both sides of a fractured mind.

  • Fast-Paced Psychological Combat
    Inspired by Hotline Miami – brutal, quick, and unforgiving.

  • Surreal Storytelling
    Told through shifting perspectives, memories, and hallucinations.

  • Unique Pixel Art Style
    With an atmosphere dripping in dread.

Combat

Wield a wide arsenal of weapons – from pistols and Uzis to shotguns and… a strangely familiar guitar.
Gunplay is satisfying, with responsive camera effects, recoil, and realistic animations.
Each weapon has its own physics, damage profile, and spread. Master them all!

Stealth and Approach

Crouch, sneak, and take down enemies with silent backstabs – but only if you're close enough to avoid being seen.
Choose your path: frontal assault or silent avoidance?

Prayer and Healing

Chapel altars allow you to pray – but not without cost.
While praying, you're immobilized, weaponless, and vulnerable.

In return, you heal your body… and your soul.
Is it a risk? Yes.
Is it worth it? Absolutely.

Paranoia and Hallucination System

The lower your HP, the more distorted the world becomes. Sounds, ghosts… and more.
Every memory contains a fragment of truth.
And in the end, no one walks away unchanged.

People of Mine is a game built for immersion.
Every element – from indecipherable ambient sounds to the claustrophobic camera design and unpredictable AI – is crafted to keep your nerves on edge.

This is not a game where you “get used to the fear.”

The soundtrack isn’t just background – it reacts to your paranoia and choices.
Lighting and shadows aren’t decoration – they’re tools of deception.
Glitches, distortions, hallucinations – these aren’t bugs. They’re symptoms.

You’ll question what’s real, what’s the system… and what’s you, slowly slipping away.

The true horror isn’t the monster.
It’s not knowing if you’re still sane.

short_description: People of Mine is a 2D psychological horror about split identity, cults, and paranoia. Fight, sneak, or pray to survive in a hallucination-filled world where the line between truth and illusion keeps fading.
supported_languages:
English*, Polish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g. NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 260X or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains strong language, disturbing themes, psychological horror, depictions of violence and trauma, and references to cult activity. Player discretion is advised.
